info.name: Twilio SendGrid Provisioning Account Point Delete System API

items.docs:
**This operation allows you to delete your recipients' personal email data**

The Delete Recipients' Email Data operation accepts a list of 5,000 `email_addresses` or a total payload size of 256Kb per request, whichever comes first. Upon a successful request with this operation, SendGrid will run a search on the email addresses provided against the SendGrid system to identify matches.
